propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields must be stored in normalized scalar form (description as text string, status and priority as exact Jira name strings like 'In Progress' and 'High') to reduce serialized size by approximately 66% without changing live field comparison logic.

The assignee field must preserve its complete vendor dict structure, all identity forms, and presence bits unchanged during baseline normalization to prevent local-wins assignments from overwriting concurrent remote assignee edits.

Normalized scalar baseline values must produce identical live compute_update_fields verdicts as their raw vendor dict equivalents when passed through real Jira inbound/outbound mappers, verified by held-out comparison oracle and corpus validation.

The pre-A3 baseline reader must accept both scalar and vendor dict field shapes to enable rollback without data migration, with rollback contingency requiring zero reconcile mutation deltas under pre-A3 code.
